verdict.justification: The project aims to improve the management and administration of business operations in Aguas de la Sabana S.A E.S.P., a private company providing water, sewage, and cleaning services. The focus is on improving the management of agreements and tariffs, client and technician/operator registration, information about routes, micro-routes, and clients, and operational resource management such as collection trucks. This aligns with the definition of Enterprise Information Systems.
